correctness.rationale: The flip-equivariant pair map turns an inner inverse into an equivariant section of the image: fixed outputs must have fixed preimages, and the two-point orbits admit paired sections. Conditional on j missed labels, the independent unordered input pairs avoid j of n² outputs, giving the exact weight (1−j/n²)^(n(n−1)/2). Its log is −j/2+j/(2n)−j²/(4n²)+O(1/n) uniformly on 0≤j≤n. The tilted occupancy partition function is (n!/nⁿ)[tⁿ](exp(t)−1+z)ⁿ. At the unique solution x∈(0,1), the associated independent box counts Y have mean 1 and variance x; their tilt conditioned on ΣY=n gives exactly the tilted vacancy law. The span-one local limit and Stirling give exp((x−1)n)/√x. To check the conditional CLT without a tail gap, put J=1{Y=0}; the conditional characteristic function at u is a ratio of Fourier integrals over v∈[−π,π] of [E exp(i(v(Y−1)+u(J−θ)/√n))]ⁿ, with u=0 in the denominator. Away from v=0 span one makes the integral exponentially small; near zero, positive definite covariance (three noncollinear support points) bounds the modulus by exp(−c n v²). With v scaled by √n, the Gaussian integral ratio gives variance θ(1−θ)−θ²/x, using Cov(Y,J)=−θ. This entails E_n/n→θ under the tilt. The bounded remaining weight converges in L¹ to exp(θ/2−θ²/4), giving both the prefactor and normalized reweighting convergence in total variation. At n=1 the exact formula has weight one, and the conditioned asymptotics concern n→∞. Finite checks were inspected, not used as proof.
residual_risks: No quantitative CLT error bound or extension to higher arity is claimed.

value.rationale: The exact prevalence of regular elements and the conditional defect are natural invariants of this monoid. The rate and prefactor quantify an exponential rarity not evident from a class count, and the change in the vacancy center plus its Gaussian variance describe a typical regular operation. The finite tilting correction is essential for the leading constant and the result is not merely recomputation of an exact table.
residual_risks: No claim of a general asymptotic theory of other transformation monoids is made.
